verdict.rationale: Docusign is an e-signature and agreement-management platform. Filing state annual reports and franchise tax is a business-formation or registered-agent service, which is a different product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Docusign ships any state-filing or tax-compliance capability; agreement 'key dates' querying is unrelated agreement metadata, not government filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform
